threshold_provenance: AutoDock Vina binding energy interpretation: values are predicted binding free energies in kcal/mol (more negative = stronger predicted binding). No universally accepted cutoffs exist for classifying Vina scores; the values here are from commonly cited benchmarking studies. Eberhardt et al., J Chem Inf Model 2021;61:3891-3898 (Vina 1.2.x). Quiroga & Villarreal, PLoS ONE 2016;11:e0155183 report that scores below -6.0 kcal/mol correspond to low-micromolar predicted affinity in their benchmark set.
